name: refract
displayName: Refract — Instant Context Grounding for VS Code Chat & Copilot
description: Ground vague coding prompts in your active files, compiler errors, and terminal output in <2ms. Stops Copilot hallucination loops and failure spirals (100% local, 0 extra tokens).

chatParticipants.name: refract
chatParticipants.description: Refract rough prompts through conversation trajectory, active files, and live diagnostics (<5ms local)

commands.name: refract
commands.description: Score and refract a prompt across 3 spectrums (⚡ Precision, 🔬 Root-Cause, 🛡️ Strict Spec)

commands.name: check
commands.description: Audit prompt & trajectory health and open the Interactive 5-Dimension Scorecard

commands.name: mode
commands.description: View or switch Refract operating mode (auto-intercept, coach, slash-only)

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Run Refract environment, diagnostics, and trajectory health check

languageModelTools.name: refract_prompt
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyzes a developer prompt against active workspace files, VS Code Problems/diagnostics, and recent terminal errors using the 5-Dimension Trajectory Rubric, returning 3 grounded prompt spectrums (Precision, Root-Cause, Strict Spec).

draftPrompt.description: The rough or ambiguous developer prompt to refract against workspace context and diagnostics.

enumDescriptions: Automatically grounds diffuse prompts in-flight and executes immediately via your active VS Code Chat model.
Shows the 5-Dimension score and lets you pick which spectrum (Precision, Root-Cause, Strict Spec) to execute.
Only refracts when explicitly invoked via /refract, /check, or Cmd+Alt+P.
refract.mode.description: Operating mode for the @refract Chat Participant and prompt interceptor.

refract.scoreThreshold.description: Prompts scoring at or above this threshold on the 5-Dimension Trajectory Rubric pass through untouched.

refract.rescueFailureSpirals.description: Automatically pivot to the Root-Cause Isolation spectrum when repeated terminal/compiler errors or frustration prompts are detected.

refract.alwaysIncludeRules.description: Custom team/project rules to attach to every refracted prompt (merged with .agents/refract.json if present).

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v && node tests/refractCore.test.js
